# FastAPI Development Skill

## When to Use
- Creating REST API endpoints
- Handling HTTP requests and responses
- Integrating with databases (SQL, NoSQL)
- Adding authentication and middleware
- Building asynchronous APIs

## Procedure
1. Analyze requirements for the API
2. Create FastAPI app structure
3. Define models and schemas with Pydantic
4. Implement endpoints with path operations
5. Add dependencies and middleware
6. Test the API
